articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: What are tokenized deposits?
articles.snippet: Banks are moving deposits on-chain using permissioned systems, not open ones. See why privacy and compliance dictate this path in this week's newsletter.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks out of six-week range, tops $71,000 as $3 billion in shorts get wiped out
articles.snippet: Six weeks of compression ended in the largest short liquidation since at least 2021, with $3 billion of bearish bets forced to buy back into thin supply.

articles.title: BitGo secures South Korea virtual asset license, says it's the first global crypto company to do so
articles.snippet: Backed by Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom, BitGo Korea built a locally registered entity from scratch to serve institutional and enterprise clients, rather than taking the acquisition route.

articles.title: Trump pushes Congress to move on Clarity Act during White House crypto event
articles.snippet: The CEOs from companies across several tech-forward sectors met with the president in advance of this week's first Innovation Advisory Committee at the CFTC.

articles.title: Bitdeer signs $400M AI cloud computing deal for Malaysia facility
articles.snippet: Bitdeer expects revenue from the five-year agreement to begin in early 2027 as it builds toward 350 megawatts of AI cloud capacity by 2028.
